summary: CLAIM C-0001: Hypnosis produces measurable, reproducible changes in brain activity and large-scale network connectivity (DMN, ECN-SN), supporting the view that it involves a real neurobiological change rather than mere role-playing.
content: CLAIM C-0001: Hypnosis is associated with measurable, reproducible changes in brain activity and functional connectivity — particularly decreased DMN activity/connectivity, altered DLPFC-insula (ECN-SN) coupling, and consistent engagement of the lingual gyrus. This supports the position that hypnosis involves a real neurobiological change in consciousness-processing, not merely social compliance. (Evidence: EV-0002, EV-0005, EV-0007, EV-0014.) COUNTER-EVIDENCE: EV-0004, EV-0012 — these changes do not establish a 'special/unique state' and may reflect suggestion effects rather than induction-specific state effects.
